fields.Extra:
Absent T-cell function compromises cellular defense and B-cell help. B-cell numbers depend on the genetic defect.
SCID phenotypeGenetic causes
T−B+IL2RG, JAK3, IL7R, PTPRC, CD3D, CD3E, CD247, CORO1A, LAT, LCP2
T−B−RAG1/2, DCLRE1C, PRKDC, NHEJ1, LIG4, ADA, AK2, RAC2 (activating), NUDCD3

Catalog of the two SCID groups in IUIS 2024; hypomorphic variants may have different phenotypes. MHC class II deficiency belongs to a separate combined-immunodeficiency group.
